title: Extended EMF Observer
text: Compute electrical position and mechanical speed of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), 6 inputs, 4 outputs, {Table data type} sets Data type of table; {Use input port for computed parameters (run-time motor swap)} sets the option to enable input port to accept computed, {Input units} sets the units of block input, {Position output} sets the type of position output Electrical, {Discrete step size (s)} sets the sample time after which block executes again, {Stator resistance (ohm)} sets the resistance, {Stator d-axis inductance (H)} sets the d -axis inductance 0.2e-3, {Maximum application speed (RPM)} sets the maximum supported mechanical speed, {Number of pole pairs}, {Maximum voltage (V)} sets the nominal voltage corresponding to one per, {Maximum current (A)} sets the nominal current corresponding to one per, {EEMF observer gain} sets the extended EMF observer gain, {EEMF filter cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets the cutoff frequency of EEMF filter, {Proportional (P)} sets the proportional gain of speed observer, {Integral (I)} sets the integral gain of the speed observer, {Number of data points for sine-cosine lookup table} sets the number of data points used for speed, {Speed filter cutoff frequency (Hz)} sets the cutoff frequency of speed filter, {Position unit} sets the unit of position, {Position data type} sets the data type of position, {Speed unit} sets the unit of speed and {Speed data type} sets the data type of speed. Values come from the instance.
